about_the_game:
Expand your adventure with four brand-new playable classes, each bringing a unique style and strategy to your party:

🛡️ The Knight
Built to protect. The Knight excels at soaking up hits with massive defense bonuses. Wield a sturdy melee strike, bolster your defenses, heal yourself, or shield allies by taking damage in their place. The Knight’s ultimate upgrade supercharges defense recovery and removes decay—letting you stack defense to near-invincible levels.

🗡️ The Assassin
The ultimate single-target eliminator. Assassins strike the back line first, cutting down enemy mages and bosses with ease. Pierce through heavy armor, unleash poison darts to melt high-health foes, or weaken defenses with Dismantle. Their ultimate adds poison damage to every attack, turning every strike into a lethal blow.

🎭 The Jester
Chaos incarnate. The Jester thrives on risk and reward with wildly unpredictable damage. A basic attack might devastate—or whiff completely—always at random targets. Roll the dice with abilities that can heal or harm everyone on screen, or land a self-damaging melee strike. Their ultimate removes all downsides, letting you enjoy the power of pure RNG without the penalty.

🦇 The Vampire
Control the fight with a mix of offense and sustain. Vampires deal heavy damage while healing themselves, grant allies regeneration, infect enemies with venomous strikes, or empower themselves by feeding on a teammate. With their ultimate, every point of damage dealt restores their health—making them nearly unstoppable.
